bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for stock status text and Add to Cart button
affected_users: older adults with reduced contrast sensitivity
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the stock status paragraph below the product image
Observe the "Add to Cart" button below the product description
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Text and button label must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against their background per WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 1.4.3.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Stock status paragraph has contrast ratio 1.6:1 (foreground #cccccc on #ffffff). Add to Cart button has contrast ratio 2.93:1 (foreground #ffffff on #ff6600). Both fall below the required 4.5:1 ratio.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for p, change color from #cccccc to #767676 (4.54:1 on #ffffff; measured 1.6:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Product image missing alternative text on product detail page
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the main product image displayed
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each element must have a descriptive alt attribute, an empty alt for decorative images, or be marked with role="none"/"presentation".
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The element has no alt attribute, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or role override.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a descriptive alt attribute, e.g., alt="Red running shoe, side view", to the img element:

bugLogs.title: Quantity input lacks an accessible label on product detail page
steps_to_reproduce: Attempt to focus the field using keyboard or screen reader
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The input must have a programmatically determinable label so that assistive technologies can announce its purpose.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <input type="number" ...> has no associated <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or placeholder, resulting in no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix:
Add a visible label and associate it with the input:

<label for="product-qty">Quantity</label>
<input id="product-qty" type="number" value="1" min="1" max="10" style="width: 50px;" aria-required="true">
